message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible, newly reported vulnerabilities were found for the deduplicated DLL/component inventory during the last 24 hours.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. Obvious aliases and duplicate rows were normalized; headings and administrative text were excluded. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-30 13:10 IST through 2026-10-31 13:10 IST (2026-10-30 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-31 07:40 UTC).

### Findings

No relevant findings passed the freshness, product-match, and source-credibility checks.

The October 30 revision of Oracle Security Alert CVE-2026-114820 was reviewed because the inventory includes legacy ODP.NET and Oracle Instant Client components. Oracle states that its Database Server patch is not applicable to client-only installations, so this was excluded as not matching the monitored components. Recent advisories for other similarly named or adjacent products were also excluded.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB security alerts, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly reported in this exact window.

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability response is indicated from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not establish that the listed legacy component versions are supported or free of older known vulnerabilities.

**Sources checked:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), [Oracle Security Alert CVE-2026-114820](https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/alert-cve-2026-114820.html), and CISA vulnerability sources.
